messages:
maya: Quick alert 1: All-hands tomorrow 9:30am PT (short 25m). Two major callouts + Q&A doc. Please add any questions here or in the doc. :loudspeaker:

maya: Agenda (25m):
- 09:30-09:35 Exec update  go-to-market + hiring ask
- 09:35-09:42 Launch highlight  hosted API scale + new "Scale" plan
- 09:42-09:48 Policy brief  incident postmortem access & retention opt-in
- 09:48-09:55 Live Q&A (we'll pull top upvoted)

maya: Q&A doc: https://docs.google.com/redwood-allhands-summer-launch (add Qs + upvote)

felix: Launch note: Hosted API now supports 4k context in GA for standard models; new "Scale" plan available with committed capacity discounts. Marketing will post the public blog after the call.

anika: Billing note: introductory promo for Scale plan: 3 months 20% off commit for early customers. Internal billing docs in Confluence; ping me for access.

samir: Policy: postmortems for Sev2+ incidents will be published to the internal incident board by default; teams can opt-out per-project. We'll also publish a short RCA summary for customer-facing incidents. Migration/opt-out steps added to the Q&A doc.

maya: @samir please add an example curl for exporting incident logs to the doc.

samir: Added export example: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/incident/export -d '{"project":"acme","range":"30d"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'```

anika: EMEA/EMAP folks: recording + slides posted immediately after; we'll run an EMEA office hour tomorrow 18:00 CET to cover region questions.

all-hands-bot: Calendar event created: All-hands  Summer Launch + Policy Update  Tomorrow 09:30 PT (link in #general).

recording-bot: Recording link (will be uploaded after meeting): https://records.redwood.co/meetings/1867002468-summer-launch.mp4 (slides: https://slides.redwood.co/allhands/1867002468)

maya: Post-meeting takeaways (short):
- Exec: approved go-to-market push for Scale plan; hiring ask for +4 sales and +3 infra engineers.
- Launch: 4k context GA for standard models; Scale plan discounts for committed capacity.
- Policy: default postmortem publishing for Sev2+; opt-out per-project; export/migration guide live.

maya: If your question in the Q&A doc wasn't answered live we'll follow up here and update the notes. Thanks all! :white_check_mark:
